# System Architecture

| Component | Module | Role |
|-----------|--------|------|
| LLMClient | src/utils/llm_client | Unified interface for multiple LLM providers |
| PlaybookManager | src/playbook/manager | Manages playbooks and bullet persistence with disk/DB |
| WorkerAgent | src/agents/worker_agent | Generates test, implementation, and refactor code via LLM |
| ExperimentLogger | src/storage/experiment_logger | Logs TDD cycles and experiments to PostgreSQL/SQLite |
| PodmanRunner | src/agents/podman_runner | Runs code in isolated Podman container |
| PodmanOrchestrator | src/agents/podman_orchestrator | Orchestrates container execution and security checks |
| PythonLanguagePod | src/agents/python_language_pod | LanguagePod implementation for Python TDD phases |
| TDDCycleRunner | src/agents/tdd_cycle_runner | Orchestrates RED → GREEN (retry) → REFACTOR cycle |
| Reflector | src/core/reflector/module | Analyzes outcomes and extracts learning insights |
| Curator | src/core/curator/module | Synthesizes insights into playbook bullets |
| Generator | src/core/generator/module | Executes tasks with playbook-guided LLM |
| BulletRetriever | src/playbook/retrieval | Retrieves relevant bullets for queries |
| ImportFilter | src/agents/import_filter | Validates for forbidden imports in generated code |
| EmbeddingService | src/utils/embedding | Generates embeddings for semantical similarity |
| TokenEfficiencyReporter | src/analytics/token_efficiency | Computes token usage and efficiency scores |
| SuccessRateCalculator | src/analytics/success_rate_calculator | Measures experiment success rates |

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Main as run_cycle.py
    participant Runner as TDDCycleRunner
    participant Pod as PythonLanguagePod
    participant Worker as WorkerAgent
    participant Orch as PodmanOrchestrator
    participant Container as PodmanRunner
    participant Logger as ExperimentLogger
    participant Reflect as Reflector
    participant Curate as Curator

    Main->>Runner: run(spec)
    activate Runner

    Runner->>Pod: run_red(spec)
    activate Pod
    Pod->>Worker: generate_test(spec, existing_code)
    Worker-->>Pod: test_code
    Pod->>Orch: pulse({test_file: test_code})
    Orch->>Container: send_pulse
    Container-->>Orch: PulseResult
    Orch-->>Pod: PhaseResult
    deactivate Pod
    Pod-->>Runner: red_result

    alt RED abort (security/policy)
        Runner->>Runner: abort cycle
        Runner-->>Main: CycleResult(success=False)
    else GREEN phase with retries
        loop up to max_green_attempts
            Runner->>Pod: run_green(spec with error_feedback)
            activate Pod
            Pod->>Worker: generate_implementation(spec, error_output)
            Worker-->>Pod: impl_code
            Pod->>Orch: pulse({test_file, impl_file})
            Orch->>Container: send_pulse
            Container-->>Orch: PulseResult
            Orch-->>Pod: PhaseResult
            deactivate Pod
            Pod-->>Runner: green_result
            alt green passed or abort
                break
            else
                update error_feedback
            end
        end
    end

    alt GREEN passed
        Runner->>Pod: run_refactor(spec)
        activate Pod
        Note over Pod: orchestrator.pulse with existing files (no new generation)
        Pod->>Orch: pulse({test_file, impl_file})
        Orch->>Container: send_pulse
        Container-->>Orch: PulseResult
        Orch-->>Pod: PhaseResult
        deactivate Pod
        Pod-->>Runner: refactor_result

        alt Learning loop
            Runner->>Reflect: reflect(task, gen_output, env_feedback)
            Reflect-->>Runner: reflector_output
            Runner->>Curate: curate(reflector_output, playbook_id)
            Curate-->>Runner: curator_output
            Curate->>PlaybookManager: apply_updates(playbook_id, delta_bullets)
        end
    end

    Runner->>Logger: log_tdd_cycle(...)
    Runner-->>Main: CycleResult
    deactivate Runner
```
